content:
Apple has rolled out developer beta 6 of the updates this morning and is now seeding public beta 4 of iOS 27 to users, along with corresponding updates for its other platforms. Here are the details.

The new round of public betas is now available

Apple just rolled out:

  • iOS 27 public beta 4: build number 24A5418b
  • iPadOS 27 public beta 4: build number 24A5418b
  • tvOS 27 public beta 4: build number 24J5353b
  • macOS 27 public beta 4: build number 26A5416b (Apple previously seeded a build numbered 26A5416a)

With only a few weeks remaining before the official release date for these systems, Apple has launched the corresponding beta 6 versions a few hours ago. This update primarily focuses on bug fixes and performance improvements.

Today's release of macOS 27 beta introduces new wallpapers and redesigns the traffic light window control buttons for macOS 27 Golden Gate. Other notable changes include:

  • The pinned messages user interface bug that appeared in beta 5 has been resolved in beta 6.
  • Updated notification animation effects on iOS
  • Updated Preview app icon on Mac, matching the iOS icon released last week

Each public beta carries the same build number as its corresponding developer beta 6, except for macOS, which has the build number 26A5416b. Update, 9:15 PM: Apple has re-released macOS 27 public beta 4 with build number 26A5416b.

To enrol your device in the public beta programme, visit https://beta.apple.com and follow the instructions to enrol each device. Here are the steps to install the public beta on your iPhone:

  • Go to the Apple Beta Software Program website and choose Sign up or Sign in.
  • Sign in with the same Apple Account you use on your iPhone, then accept the programme terms and enrol your account.
  • Open Settings on your iPhone.
  • Go to General > Software Update > Beta Updates.
  • Choose iOS 27 Public Beta.
  • Go back to the Software Update screen, and when the beta appears, tap Download and Install.

Apple recommends installing beta software on a secondary device. If you're using your primary iPhone, be sure to make a fresh backup first.

Notice anything new in this beta? Tell us about it in the comments.
